name: io.github.mikegianfelice/githired
title: GitHired
description: Canada-eligible tech jobs from employer ATS boards. Read-only search, match, stats.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search Canada-eligible technology jobs (plus optional worldwide-remote roles labeled remote_scope=global) tracked by GitHired from employer ATS boards. Canada/province matches rank above global. Returns compact results with original apply URLs and remote_scope. Province accepts codes (ON) or full names (Ontario). Use exclude_global_remote=true or remote_scope to filter. Does not invent jobs or salaries.

keywords.description: Free-text keyword query matched against title, company, location, track, seniority, and technologies (not description-only). Example: "data engineer pyspark".

location.description: Substring filter on the job location label (and province when present). Example: "Toronto" or "Remote".

province.description: Canadian province filter. Accepts two-letter codes (ON, BC, QC, …) or full names (Ontario), case-insensitive. Unrecognized values return a validation error.

remote.description: When true, keep remote-friendly listings; when false, exclude remote work_arrangement. Omit for no remote filter.

work_mode.description: Exact work arrangement filter. Allowed: remote | hybrid | onsite. Omit for any arrangement.

remote_scope.description: Exact remote_scope match. Allowed: canada | province | americas | global | local | unspecified. global = explicit worldwide/anywhere remote (null province).

exclude_global_remote.description: When true, drop remote_scope=global jobs. Default when omitted: include global (ranked below Canada/province).

salary_disclosed.description: true: only jobs with an employer-advertised annual salary; false: only jobs without; omit for either.

minimum_salary.description: Minimum advertised annual base pay in CAD (employer-advertised only; USD converted with the dataset FX rate). Non-positive values are ignored. Example: 150000.

seniority.description: Seniority band filter. Allowed: intern, junior, mid, senior, staff, principal, lead (aliases sr/jr accepted). Case-insensitive.

company.description: Case-insensitive substring match on company name. Example: "Shopify".

limit.description: Page size. Integer from 1 to 25 inclusive. Default: 20 (MCP caps at 25).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor. Omit on the first page.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: List companies in the current dataset with their active job counts. Optional name filter performs a case-insensitive substring search. Useful for discovering which employers GitHired currently tracks.

name.description: Optional case-insensitive substring match on company name. Example: "cohere". Omit to list all companies (up to limit).

limit.description: Maximum companies to return. Integer from 1 to 500. Default: 250.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information for one GitHired job by its stable id, including description excerpt when present. Use search_jobs or match_profile first to obtain ids.

id.description: Stable GitHired job id from search_jobs / match_profile (hex string). Required. Example: "a372d357d8537eef".

tools.name: match_profile
tools.description: Deterministically match skills/experience preferences to GitHired jobs. Uses role-family title matching (not exact titles). work_arrangements is a hard filter when set; remote_preference=true alone means remote-only. salary_mode defaults to flexible (advertised max may meet floor). Scores are relevance, not hire probability. Does not store résumés or call an LLM.

skills.description: Skill keywords to confirm against listing tags/technologies (e.g. ["Python", "Kubernetes"]). Unconfirmed skills are noted as gaps, not auto-rejections.

years_experience.description: Candidate years of experience (non-negative number). Used with seniority to score fit against years required in the listing when present. Example: 5.

preferred_roles.description: Preferred job titles; matched by role-family tokens (e.g. "Senior Data Engineer" also matches "Data Platform Engineer").

preferred_locations.description: Preferred cities or provinces (codes or names). Remote jobs still match when remote is allowed. Examples: ["Toronto", "ON"].

remote_preference.description: Legacy arrangement hint. true → remote-only hard filter when work_arrangements is omitted. Ignored when work_arrangements is provided.

work_arrangements.description: Hard allow-list of work arrangements. Values: remote | hybrid | onsite. Overrides remote_preference when provided. Example: ["remote", "hybrid"].

minimum_salary.description: CAD-normalized annual base pay floor (employer-advertised only). Compared using salary_mode. Example: 140000.

salary_mode.description: Salary floor semantics. strict: advertised min must meet floor. flexible (default): advertised max may meet floor.

seniority.description: Preferred seniority band for scoring (intern, junior, mid, senior, staff, principal, lead; sr/jr aliases). Influences match_score; not a hard exclude alone.

limit.description: Maximum matches to return. Integer from 1 to 25. Default: 10.

tools.name: get_market_stats
tools.description: Aggregate statistics from GitHired's tracked Canadian tech employer dataset — not a full labour-market census. Includes by_remote_scope so worldwide-remote (global) jobs are counted under remote_scope=global, not as Canadian provinces. Optional filters narrow the aggregate before counting.

role.description: Optional substring filter on title or track (e.g. "data engineer" or "platform"). Case-insensitive.

province.description: Optional Canadian province code filter (e.g. ON, BC). Compared to job.province exactly (case-insensitive).

seniority.description: Optional exact seniority band filter (intern, junior, mid, senior, staff, principal, lead). Case-insensitive.

work_arrangement.description: Optional exact work arrangement filter. Allowed: remote | hybrid | onsite.

remote_scope.description: Optional exact remote_scope filter before aggregating. Allowed: canada | province | americas | global | local | unspecified.

exclude_global_remote.description: When true, exclude remote_scope=global jobs from aggregates. Default when omitted: include them under by_remote_scope.global.
